Hymn 248: Up, Awake, Ye Defenders of Zion
Time Signature: 6/8
Musical Key: B-flat Major
Composer: Thomas E. Daniels
Lyricist/Text Author: Charles W. Penrose
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 248 titled "Up, Awake, Ye Defenders of Zion" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 6/8 time signature. 
The music was composed by Thomas E. Daniels and the lyrics were written by Charles W. Penrose.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
